text:
julia: heads-up — ap-southeast-2 GPU nodepool gpu-np-1 at 100% alloc, ~140 pods Pending. autoscaler keeps failing scale-ups.
infra-bot: [ALERT] gpu-pool-depleted ap-southeast-2 — 140 pods pending · 90% GPU util · https://metrics.internal/redwood/alert/1767012345 :rotating_light:
sam: @julia can you list pending pods? are these user workloads or batch jobs?
julia: mostly batch: lots of batch-inference-summarizer-* jobs from the cronjob. many in Pending with reason "InsufficientGPU".
devon: seeing repeated kubelet errors in events: `AttachNetworkInterface: ResourceLimitExceeded` — cloud says ENI limit hit in subnet-az-2. autoscaler requests nodes but can't attach NICs.
marta: opened cloud support ticket (INC-123456): "ENI quota in subnet-az-2 reached". vendor estimated ETA 3–4h for quota bump.
sam: oof. so autoscaler isn't the limiter — it's ENI attachment in the AZ + nodegroup is non-preemptible. options: suspend cronjobs, create spot-backed nodepool in another AZ, or reduce concurrency.
julia: already suspended the cronjob: `kubectl patch cronjob batch-inference-summarizer -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'` — stopped new runs. freed some pending after killing in-flight pods.
devon: we still have long-running jobs on GPUs; if we over-evict we lose progress. prefer to kill newest pending ones first.
sam: quick mitigation plan:
• suspend cronjob (done)
• selectively delete oldest Pending pods that never bound
• spawn a spot-backed nodepool in az-3 as temporary capacity
• request ENI quota bump
marta: created temp spot nodepool in az-3 with label `spot=true` and node taint `spot=true:NoSchedule`. command used: `kctl nodegroup create gpu-spot-temp --az az-3 --instance-type a100 --max 20 --labels spot=true` — nodes booting.
deploy-bot: deployment "hotfix/cron-limits" rolled out to kube-system (added parallelism limit override for cronjobs).
devon: additional logs: `kube-controller-manager` shows CronJob controller pushed many Jobs because `concurrencyPolicy: Allow` + new schedule `*/3 * * * *` in last deploy — that change caused overlapping runs.
julia: root cause: bad change in deployment (concurrencyPolicy + aggressive schedule) + infra limit (ENI) exposing problem. two separate failure modes aligned.
sam: immediate follow-ups:
• oncall to own postmortem (assigned)
• add admission webhook preventing cronjobs without `spec.suspend` default or `spec.parallelism` cap
• add nodegroup with preemptible capacity in same AZs as fallback (but need ENI calculations)
• add alert for "ENI attach errors" separate from nodepool GPU utilization
marta: cloud support updated ticket with subnet expansion request and will escalate if no ETA in 1h. ticket ref: INC-123456.
devon: longer-term: require `priorityClass` for GPU jobs, implement checkpointing for batch inference, and make autoscaler aware of ENI quotas so it can fail faster to alternative AZs.
sam: I'll create the incident page and start the timeline + runbook entries. assigning postmortem owner: @sam.
julia: thanks — freed 18 GPUs by deleting stuck pods, new spot nodes just joined (2/20), pending count down to 24.
infra-bot: [INFO] spot nodepool gpu-spot-temp registered 2 nodes · 18 pending remain.
sam: keep updates here, but I'm taking postmortem and actions. great quick work everyone :thumbsup:
